findings.issue: Stale-render guard is checked only after page functions have already written root.innerHTML, so a slow route resolving after a newer navigation overwrites the fresh page
findings.suggestion: Pass the token (or an AbortController) into page renderers and check it before they touch the DOM, or have render() own all root writes

findings.issue: The 200 ms search debounce timer survives navigation; when it fires it replaceStates the URL to /?q=… while a different route is displayed
findings.suggestion: Cancel the timer on unmount/route change (e.g. an AbortController or token check inside the timeout)

findings.issue: /pokemon/ with an empty name fetches the species list and crashes into the generic Error page instead of the required Not found
findings.suggestion: Validate the extracted route param and route to renderNotFound when empty

findings.issue: All API payloads are `any` despite strict TypeScript, so the shapes the whole app depends on are untyped
findings.suggestion: Declare interfaces for the records actually consumed (species, pokemon, move, type) in a shared types module

findings.issue: Column sorting reconstructs MoveRow data by parsing rendered textContent and hrefs out of the DOM — fragile against any markup or formatting change
findings.suggestion: Keep the MoveRow[] data in a closure (or data attribute / WeakMap keyed by row) and re-render from it

findings.issue: Near-duplicate of speciesFromPokemonRefs in data.ts, re-implemented to carry the hidden flag
findings.suggestion: Extend speciesFromPokemonRefs with an option to retain per-ref metadata instead of a second copy of the mapping logic

findings.issue: Module-level mutable sectionCounter mints heading IDs; hidden global state that keeps incrementing across renders
findings.suggestion: Derive the id from the title or have the caller pass one; drop the counter

findings.issue: Two navigation paths coexist: the nav.ts bus used by main.ts and direct history[replace|push]State in home.ts, so URL changes can bypass the render pipeline
findings.suggestion: Route home.ts through navigate() (or give nav.ts a replace+no-render variant) so one module owns history writes

findings.issue: decodeURIComponent on the request path can throw for malformed URIs and returns a 500 instead of 404
findings.suggestion: try/catch the decode and fall through to the 404 branch

findings.issue: Moves section fans out to one fetch per unique move (hundreds for a Pokémon like Mew) per first visit, all through the unbounded apiJson cache
findings.suggestion: Acceptable against a local API, but consider a small concurrency limiter or a batched render for very large tables

summary: A disciplined, well-layered vanilla TS/Vite SPA that picks the right primitives (delegated navigation, promise-deduped fetch cache, memoized derived data) and escapes HTML consistently, so most of it I'd merge after a nit round. Two real bugs block approval: the render-race guard runs after pages write the DOM so a stale slow route can overwrite the current page, and the home-page debounce can replaceState the wrong URL after navigation. Fix those, type the API payloads, and untangle the two navigation paths, and this is a solid 4.
